name: Shadow Presence
description: Escape the Underworld with the Shadow Presence talent active (it gives Attack and Special +10% damage per rank when striking foes from behind).

name: Fiery Presence
description: Escape the Underworld with the Fiery Presence talent active (it gives Attack and Special +15% damage per rank when striking undamaged foes).

name: Chthonic Vitality
description: Escape the Underworld with the Chthonic Vitality talent active (each rank restores 1 Health when you exit a chamber).

name: Dark Regeneration
description: Escape the Underworld with the Dark Regeneration talent active (each rank makes +30% of any Darkness you collect restore your Health by that much).

name: Death Defiance
description: Escape the Underworld with the Death Defiance talent active (each rank restores you for 50% Health, once, when your Life Total is depleted).

name: Stubborn Defiance
description: Escape the Underworld with the Stubborn Defiance talent active (it restores you to 30% Health, once per chamber, when your Life Total is depleted).

name: Greater Reflex
description: Escape the Underworld with the Greater Reflex talent active (each rank lets you chain one extra Dash before briefly recovering).

name: Ruthless Reflex
description: Escape the Underworld with the Ruthless Reflex talent active (dashing just before getting hit gives +50% damage and dodge chance for 2 seconds).

name: Boiling Blood
description: Escape the Underworld with the Boiling Blood talent active (each rank gives +10% Attack and Special damage to foes carrying your Cast Ammo).

name: Abyssal Blood
description: Escape the Underworld with the Abyssal Blood talent active (each rank reduces the speed and damage of foes carrying your Cast Ammo by -6%).

name: Infernal Soul
description: Escape the Underworld with the Infernal Soul talent active (each rank gives +1 Cast Ammo for your Cast).

name: Stygian Soul
description: Escape the Underworld with the Stygian Soul talent active (your Cast Ammo regenerates instead of dropping, 1 second faster per rank).

name: Deep Pockets
description: Escape the Underworld with the Deep Pockets talent active (each rank grants 10 Obols at the start of each escape from the House of Hades).

name: Golden Touch
description: Escape the Underworld with the Golden Touch talent active (each rank grants +5% of your Obols total each time you clear an Underworld region).

name: Thick Skin
description: Escape the Underworld with the Thick Skin talent active (each rank adds +5 Health to your Life Total).

name: High Confidence
description: Escape the Underworld with the High Confidence talent active (each rank gives +5% damage while you have 80% Health or greater).

name: Privileged Status
description: Escape the Underworld with the Privileged Status talent active (each rank gives +20% damage against foes afflicted by at least two Status Curse effects).

name: Family Favorite
description: Escape the Underworld with the Family Favorite talent active (each rank gives +2.5% damage for each different Olympian whose Boons you hold).

name: Olympian Favor
description: Escape the Underworld with the Olympian Favor talent active (each rank adds a 1% bonus chance for a Boon to be Rare).

name: Dark Foresight
description: Escape the Underworld with the Dark Foresight talent active (each rank gives +2% greater chance for Gold Laurel rewards).

name: Gods' Pride
description: Escape the Underworld with the Gods' Pride talent active (each rank adds a 1% bonus chance for a Boon to be Epic).

name: Gods' Legacy
description: Escape the Underworld with the Gods' Legacy talent active (each rank gives +1% greater chance for a Boon to be Legendary or a Duo).

name: Fated Authority
description: Escape the Underworld with the Fated Authority talent active (each rank gives one die, used to alter the reward for the next chamber).

name: Fated Persuasion
description: Escape the Underworld with the Fated Persuasion talent active (each rank gives one die, used to alter Boon and Well of Charon choices).
